params.prompt: Technical architectural cutaway animation of an ancient Korean earthen burial mound at true scale: the mound is about 47 metres wide and 12.7 metres tall, the tiny static human silhouette at the left base is 1.7 metres, and the small timber chamber at the centre is only about 6.6 metres long, a small box deep inside a vast hill. IMPORTANT: do not render any numbers, measurement labels, dimension lines, arrows, tick marks or text of any kind anywhere in the frame; convey the scale only through the silhouette and the proportions themselves. The camera performs one slow, smooth orbital move of about 15 degrees around the cross-section, revealing the layered interior: the small timber chamber, a thick dome of river stones packed over it, and the wide earth mound covering everything. The glowing orange structure lines stay crisp and continuous throughout as an overlay. Dark neutral grey background, no sky. Subtle floating dust motes only. No people other than the static scale silhouette, no logos, no flicker. Steady, deliberate, museum-exhibit pacing.
